user_description: particle intentional cosmic coloring, harmonic contrast of texture
formal_reading: Deep nebula palette — ember-orange and magenta cores bleeding into indigo-black voids. Fine grain texture in luminous zones contrasts against smooth gradient periphery, creating a harmonic tension between material density and translucency.
particle_art_vectors: HSL nebula sampling: warm hue cores (15-40°) fading to cold (220-270°) at low luminance. Contrast particle size by local density — tight clusters use 1-2px, sparse halos use 4-8px with low alpha. Add subtle turbulence noise only at boundary zones.
priority_directive: Spawn cosmic nebula palette — warm ember cores bleeding into deep indigo — contrast fine-grain particle clusters against smooth low-density halos

user_description: zoom in infinity loop where each loop is slightly different pattern
formal_reading: Droste-effect infinite zoom: self-similar nested structures where each recursive level carries a distinct micro-variation in form. The eye travels inward perpetually without arriving at rest — a visual equivalent of the Mandelbrot boundary.
particle_art_vectors: Logarithmic camera dolly-in loop over fractal-growth skeleton. Each depth level mutates spawn density and hue by ±12% from parent. Use CatmullRom curve interpolation for smooth continuous zoom. Ensure loop closure by matching final frame particle field to initial.

Port three OMZG Shader Royale (12/02/2021, 1st place) techniques into this piece. (1) KIFS spatial partitioning: apply 2 iterations of abs(position) + time-driven rotation to divide the particle field into 8 mirror-reflected sectors; each sector gets a distinct hue derived from its sign-encoded ID hash — adjacent sectors should contrast warmth/coolness. (2) Luminous boundary haze: spawn a second particle layer (large, 8-12px, alpha 0.03-0.06) that concentrates near the sector-boundary planes, creating translucent volumetric glow at the cuts between sectors. (3) RGB color channel rotation: in the vertex or fragment stage, slowly rotate the (r, b) color channels via a time-driven mat2 (period ~30s), creating a continuous iridescent hue drift across the whole scene without changing geometry.

priority_directive: Crystalline lattice growth: particles snap to hexagonal grid nodes, propagate via reaction-diffusion rules, zero hand-placement — pure cellular automaton logic, cold mineral formation.
